Open lake water fills r<0.85 (half axes 308,154); quiet lighter shallow band r=0.85..1; waterline r=1, half axes 362,181 through (874,512),(512,693),(150,512),(512,331). Shallow band is calm and lightly lighter, not surf. Margin is narrow dark damp mud and a little sand with SMALL FLAT limestone #BCA98B and slate #626B6C pebbles, sparse tiny moss #78804C pigment patches. Lakes have NO beach: no dry sand band. Only bank lip varies by light: a little lighter on lower-right half (shore slopes up toward upper-left source) and a little darker on upper-left half. Keep width constant; do not darken entire water by angle.
Smooth painted contours, broad clusters, 3 or 4 shades per material, no per-pixel noise or stair steps. No black outline. Nothing at or above cursor white #ECE4D0. No reeds, standing rocks, boulders, plants, piers, boats, people, shadows, extra ground, text, borders, glow or diamond line. Preserve guide scale/position and spacious transparent margins. This is a raw material painting, not finished tile pieces.
